description: This file defines the AOPInboundEmail class, which extends the InboundEmail class, and provides methods for processing image links within emails and handling email-based case creation in a CRM system (SuiteCRM). It includes logic for integrating email content with CRM entities like Cases, Notes, Accounts, and Contacts, as well as handling email replies and auto-responses.

classes.name: AOPInboundEmail
classes.description: A subclass of InboundEmail customized to handle processing email image links and creating cases from emails in the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: processImageLinks
methods.description: Replaces embedded image links with links to the corresponding notes in the CRM, based on a whitelist of note IDs.

methods.name: handleCreateCase
methods.description: Main method to handle creating a CRM case from an email, including associating notes, accounts, contacts, and optionally sending auto-responses.
